Care begins with understanding.

Kemi founded Eero Therapeutic Services in 2020 to strengthen youth and families in New Jersey through accessible, compassionate mental-health support. Eero’s work puts the experiences of young people and their families at the center of care.

She earned a master’s degree in social work from Rutgers University, concentrating on clinical practice with children and families. Her published clinical background includes individual and group therapy with children, adolescents, and adults, as well as play-based approaches.

Areas of experience

Her clinical biography describes work with emotional and behavioral concerns, anxiety and depression, self-esteem, grief and loss, trauma, developmental and learning disabilities, and addiction.

Children & adolescentsFamily supportEmotional wellbeingBehavioral concernsGrief & lossTrauma support

Languages

English, Yoruba, and Hausa.

A thoughtful, supportive approach.

Eero emphasizes respect for each family’s lived experience and offers support in community and home settings. The goal is to make it easier for families to connect with help and take the next step.

Approaches described in her brochure

Kemi describes an individualized style, shaped around each young person and family. Her brochure includes the Nurtured Heart Approach, play therapy, cognitive behavioral therapy, art therapy, motivational interviewing, solution-focused therapy, and trauma-focused work.
